_comment: Queue consumed by the autonomous content engine (see docs/content-engine.md). Each run takes the first batch whose "status" is "pending", produces it, and flips it to "done" in the same commit. Add new batches to the end. Keep batches small (<=4 templates+posts) to protect quality. Every slug must be distinct from what already exists and target a real search query — no filler.
